summary: Benchmarks opened sharply lower as traders cut risk ahead of the 10 am RBI announcement, giving back part of the past two sessions' gains on oil-led inflation worries.

detail.leaders: Few early gainers; IT supported by record US tech close
detail.tone: Weaker than the pre-open note expected: the Nifty opened down 163 points (0.72%) at 22,613 and the Sensex fell about 440 points.
watch: RBI's decision at 10 am: anything beyond 25 bps would deepen the fall

top.title: Market trims risk 30 minutes before RBI
top.line: Street widely expects a 25 bps hike; inflation worries from high oil weigh
